label: Contracts
description: Discovers, loads, validates, and exposes framework and module contract definitions.

registry.description: Snapshot of contract metadata, excluding the mutable contract definitions. Each entry contains id, url, path, moduleId, label, description, icon, size, status, and time.

getContractItemById.description: Gets a contract registry record by its ID; returns undefined if not found or before initialization. The record includes the contract definition and metadata.

returns.description: The frozen contract registry item, or undefined.

getContractById.description: Gets the validated contract definition by ID; returns undefined if not found or before initialization.

returns.description: The deep-frozen contract definition, or undefined.
